topic: Before You Buy an AI Tool: A 6-Box Pilot Brief

boxes.safe_instruction: Name one task, its current owner, the trigger that starts it and the output that marks it complete.
Record current time, error, rework or queue evidence using a consistent method. If no baseline exists, observe first.
boxes.labels: TIME · ERROR · REWORK · QUEUE · OBSERVE FIRST

boxes.safe_instruction: List the data the pilot may use, the data it must not use and the approved storage or access path.
Identify who reviews outputs, what requires approval and when the workflow must stop or return to a person.
boxes.labels: REVIEW · APPROVAL · STOP · RETURN TO PERSON

boxes.safe_instruction: Choose one observable process measure and one quality check. Define how both will be recorded.
boxes.labels: PROCESS MEASURE · QUALITY CHECK · RECORD BOTH

boxes.safe_instruction: At the review date, choose: proceed, revise or stop. Record the evidence and owner for the next decision.

minimum_pilot_record: task · owner · trigger · baseline · allowed data · restricted data · reviewer · stop condition · process measure · quality check · review date · exit decision
